alternatives.name: FIRST_OBSERVED_AND_ENGAGEMENT_SNAPSHOTS
tradeoffs: Higher storage than using final engagement totals; prevents leakage.

decision.summary: Social research uses first_observable_time and scheduled engagement snapshots. Final engagement totals are forbidden as features for early-horizon prediction.
decision.title: First-observed and engagement snapshot semantics

effectivity.non_authorization_statement: Proposed status does not authorize social data ingestion or model training on live social feeds.
